items.title: Deadline to file Einspruch against the 2025 income tax assessment
items.quote: Wer diesen Bescheid für fehlerhaft hält, kann dagegen innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch erheben.
items.computation: Document is dated Thursday 19.11.2026, assumed to be the day it was handed to the post. The letter itself states the current legal rule (§122 Abs. 2 AO as amended in 2025): a letter sent by ordinary post counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after being posted. Counting from 19.11.2026: +1=20.11 (Fri), +2=21.11 (Sat), +3=22.11 (Sun), +4=23.11.2026 (Mon). 23.11.2026 is a Monday, not a Saturday/Sunday/holiday, so no shift under §122 Abs.2 Satz 3 AO is needed; Bekanntgabe = 23.11.2026. The one-month Einspruchsfrist (§355 AO) runs per §108 Abs.1 AO i.V.m. §188 Abs.2 BGB and ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the Bekanntgabe day: 23.12.2026. 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in Saarland (Heiligabend 24.12. is not itself a statutory holiday in SL), so the deadline stands.
